title: Chop a Tree
instruction: Select your Axe [1] and Left-Click a tree to gather Wood.

title: Craft a Workbench
instruction: Press [C] to open Crafting and craft a Workbench using Wood.

title: Forge a Sword
instruction: Place your Workbench with Right-Click and craft a Sword nearby.

title: Strike an Enemy
instruction: Equip your Sword and Left-Click an enemy to fight (no damage taken in Tutorial!).

title: Build a Wall
instruction: Select Wooden Wall on your hotbar and Right-Click to place shelter walls.
